$schema_note: Machine-readable architecture component/relationship table for TCAD-Dev, built by direct source verification on 2026-09-05 against commit 2ab8c2b. See docs/TCAD-System-Architecture-Developer-Guide.md for full prose detail and citations.

process_tiers.name: MPI worker pool
process_tiers.conditional: 3D, >20000 nodes, safe split axis, mpi4py+mpirun present

components.name: QML/UI Layer
components.responsibility: Presentation only; binds to controller properties/signals

components.name: Controllers
components.responsibility: Qt object graph exposed to QML; per-domain orchestration

components.name: Services
components.responsibility: Subprocess lifecycle, wire-format serialization, project persistence, result loading

components.name: Visualization Canvas
components.responsibility: 2D Matplotlib-in-QML rendering across all result modes

components.name: Workbench Core
components.responsibility: Domain objects: Region, DomainDevice, ModelCatalog, MaterialLibrary, device templates

components.name: Workbench Adapters
components.responsibility: Lossless DomainDevice <-> DeviceSpec/StructureModel conversion

components.name: Workbench Solver Backend
components.responsibility: SolverBackend protocol; pytcad backend (thin wrapper) and optional devsim backend

components.name: Workbench Analysis
components.responsibility: Post-solve observables over already-solved field arrays

components.name: Workbench Physics
components.responsibility: Analysis-only diagnostics (impact ionization, tunneling); NOT Jacobian-coupled
components.notes: re-exports pytcad/ionization.py as single source of truth

components.name: Workbench Deck DSL
components.responsibility: Plain-text TEMPLATE/BIAS/SWEEP deck parser, converts into the same Structure session

components.name: Solver Subprocess Entry Point
components.responsibility: Builds mesh+device from DeviceSpec, dispatches Newton solve, size-gates engine selection, optionally spawns MPI

components.name: MPI Worker Entry Point
components.responsibility: Overlapping additive Schwarz domain decomposition across 4 MPI ranks

components.name: Mesh Subsystem
components.path: pytcad/pytcad/mesh.py, mesh2d.py, mesh3d.py, gmsh_mesh*.py, unstructured_*.py, adapt*.py
components.responsibility: 1D/2D/3D structured meshing, optional gmsh unstructured path, adaptive refinement

components.name: Materials/Physics
components.responsibility: Semiconductor physics models: mobility, bandgap narrowing, recombination, impact ionization, BTBT, Fermi-Dirac

components.name: Impact Ionization Core
components.responsibility: van Overstraeten-de Man impact ionization, Jacobian-coupled

components.name: Device Solvers (1D/2D/3D)
components.responsibility: Newton-Jacobian drift-diffusion solve; frozen except by explicit milestone amendment

components.name: Linear Algebra
components.responsibility: One-way linear-solve dispatch: direct/gmres/bicgstab/gpu_direct + preconditioners
components.notes: never imports pytcad_device (one-way dependency, by design)

components.name: Transient Extension
components.responsibility: Backward-Euler/theta-scheme time integration, drives Device1D/2D externally

components.name: AC/Y-parameter Extension
components.responsibility: Small-signal Y-parameters via perturbed converged DC Jacobian

components.name: Density-Gradient Extension
components.responsibility: Quantum-correction analysis solver; device.py imports only _dg_prefactor

components.name: Thermal Extension
components.responsibility: Self-heating outer Gummel loop (isothermal DD + separate lattice-temperature solve)

components.name: Continuation Drivers
components.responsibility: Bias-ramp continuation for Device1D avalanche/fold tracing
components.notes: TEST-ONLY: no production module calls this, verified by repo-wide grep

components.name: Result Storage
components.responsibility: Typed in-memory result objects loaded from .npz/.json

relationships.sync: sync (blocks solver subprocess only, not GUI)

relationships.mechanism: direct import/call, one ordinary Device3D solve per rank

relationships.notes: high-risk coupling: private-looking functions reused across modules

relationships.mechanism: calls device._residual_jacobian() externally, never modifies device.py

roleNames()/backing-data detail for the 7 QML-exposed Qt models
exact QML consumer of the errorRaised signal (ErrorDialog.qml suspected, not grep-confirmed)
whether a dedicated pytcad/tests/ MPI-path core test file exists beyond gui/tests/test_mpi_schwarz_allow_run_as_root_bug.py
any GUI top-level exception handler beyond Qt's own default
standalone CLI entry point for the workbench deck DSL outside the GUI/tests
bench_device3d.py's actual output values (script and instrumentation exist; no recorded run output found)
